connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

featureId.description: Feature that anchors this schedule. Required when ruleId/environment are set.

ruleId.description: Rule to attach as the initial target. Requires featureId and environment.

environment.description: Environment of the target rule. Requires featureId and ruleId.

steps[].description:
Ordered ramp steps. When featureId+ruleId+environment are provided,
`targetId` and `patch.ruleId` in actions are auto-injected — only
supply the patch fields you want to change.

endActions[].description: Actions applied when the ramp completes. targetId and patch.ruleId are auto-injected when featureId+ruleId+environment are provided.

templateId.description: Load steps and endActions from a saved template (featureId+ruleId+environment must also be set for auto-injection)

id.description: The id of the requested resource

name.description: The display name of the Saved Group

condition.description: When type = 'condition', this is the JSON-encoded condition for the group

values.description: When type = 'list', this is the list of values for the attribute key

owner.description: The userId or email address of the owner. If an email address is provided, it will be used to look up the userId of the matching organization member. If an ID is provided, it will be validated as existing in the organization.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

put.description: Updates an existing segment in GrowthBook.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The id of the requested resource

owner.description: The userId or email address of the owner. If an email address is provided, it will be used to look up the userId of the matching organization member. If an ID is provided, it will be validated as existing in the organization.

datasourceId.description: ID of the datasource this segment belongs to

projects.description: List of project IDs for projects that can access this segment

managedBy.description: Where this Segment must be managed from. If not set (empty string), it can be managed from anywhere.

type.description: GrowthBook supports two types of Segments, SQL and FACT. SQL segments are defined by a SQL query, and FACT segments are defined by a fact table and filters.

query.description: SQL query that defines the Segment. This is required for SQL segments.

factTableId.description: ID of the fact table this segment belongs to. This is required for FACT segments.

filters.description: Optional array of fact table filter ids that can further define the Fact Table based Segment.
